title: Ebola death toll in DR Congo passes 5,000
paragraphs: The death toll from Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has surpassed 5,000, government data show, with authorities yet to find a way to control the country’s deadliest outbreak of the virus on record.
The latest death toll was announced on Friday.
Ebola has infected more than 10,000 people in the DRC since the outbreak was declared in May.
